commit_message:
[DispatchCreation] Allow hoisting of set_encoding through generics with a transposed output map (#24800)

This patch enables more opportunities to hoist `set_encoding` through
`linalg.generic` with non-identity output maps, e.g. cases when dequant
and transpose are fused together.
